about: Quote (issue #97): text selected in one chat message, added to the message box as a Markdown quote. Every app's Quote is checked against these cases: public/quote.js (web) and Quote.kt (Android).
blocks: { name, selected, quote }. selected is the text as the selection gives it; quote is what goes in the message box, '' when there is nothing to quote (no button, no menu item).

The rules: line breaks become \n and a no-break space a space; each line loses the spaces at its end; blank lines at the start and the end go, and several blank lines in a row are one; each line gets '> ' in front, a blank line '>'. No author name is added.
adds: { name, draft, selected, text }. draft is what the message box held; text what it holds after Quote, null when nothing is added (the box stays as it was). The cursor is at the end of text.

The quote goes after the draft: a draft that is only spaces or line breaks goes; any other draft keeps its words, loses the spaces and line breaks at its end, and is followed by a blank line. The quote is followed by a blank line, so the cursor is on a new line after it.
